title: 英文第三、4題｜Does 問句改為現在式被動
question:
請將主動句改為被動句。
Does Mr. Huang make the longest kite in the world?
answer: Is the longest kite in the world made by Mr. Huang?
explanation: 原問句由 Does 起頭，時態是現在簡單式。改為被動後，原受詞 the longest kite in the world 成為單數主詞，搭配 is made。問句把 is 移到句首，原主詞 Mr. Huang 放到 by 後。Was 會把句子變成過去簡單式。
studentAnswer: Was the longest kite in the world made by Mr. Huang? → Is the longest kite in the world made by Mr. Huang?（紅筆訂正）
subject: English
trap: 主被動互換先保留時態，再決定被動句主詞的單複數。Does 對應現在式，單數風箏用 is made。
